I’ve been to this clinic quite a few times already, and I keep coming back because the staff—especially the therapists—are always very kind, helpful, and professional. The level of care is excellent, and the clinic is extremely clean and well-maintained, which I really appreciate.

The only downside for me is the parking situation. The parking area is located right by the main road, and it can be difficult to find a spot. Sometimes, if other guests have already parked in front of the clinic, I have to find parking further away and walk, which isn’t very convenient.

Aside from this small inconvenience, everything else about the clinic is great. I truly appreciate the service and care they provide.

Meniscus tears can be painful and wait for the MRI takes time. They make first clear that they will be no replacement for a surgery, if needed. But they can help with the pain.
After diagnosics I got herbs flamed at my knee and a medical massage. After I could move my knee much more and was without pain.
The clinic is modern and very clean and the people are friendly and have a good knowledge. The price is fair.

Excellent!  Chujai was recommended to me by the massage place I go to.  I had a strained back.  It was very painful.  The people at Chujai are professional, friendly, and understand how to make people feel better fast.  I am very happy!Chujai can even do the spine decompression like chiropractors do on YouTube! They also did cupping and a targeted massage.  I absolutely recommend this clinic.  If you are reading this, I imagine you are in pain.  Go to Chujai and feel better soon!

I ran in a marathon last year. I really injured my knee. I had an MRI. The doctor told me I couldn't exercise. It was awful. 9 months later, I still hadn't exercised for almost a year. I was NOT very hopeful when I went to Choojai because I'm not really that familiar with Thai Traditional medicine and I didn't think anything could help after physical therapy with lasers and ultrasounds and anti-inflammatory medications didn't help. I was very skeptical when herbs were put on my knee and set on fire. It looked really cool, but I didn't see how it could help.

But guess what? IT DID. It's not just ONE treatment and you're fixed, but the Thai Traditional doctors have a diagnosis process that is far more personal and attentive than when you visit a hospital. They use different techniques to identify problem areas. They actually know what they are doing with their hands. They don't just press in one or two spots and make a diagnosis. They really check everywhere.

Now, after several weeks of treatments, my knee is starting to feel better. I can actually walk down stairs without being in pain.

I'm undergoing treatment for another issue now that has bothered me for YEARS and Choojai Clinic is the first place that has made any progress. I'd give them 6 stars if I could. It changed my life.
One of the best therapist in the world, I really feel much better than before especially when they crack my back. Unforgettable moments

I was very impressed. The service was excellent, and they treated my pain effectively. The clinic was clean, and they paid attention to every detail for their clients. I also received postpartum confinement care, and I felt much better afterward. ❤️

It couldn't cure my symptoms. I'm not sure about others. I paid 1,000 baht per massage. After the massage, my symptoms improved, but afterward, the pain returned. I tried blood transfusions as recommended by the doctor, but it didn't work. In short, if you have pain or injury, I'm not sure if this will cure it. If it's just to relieve the pain and tightness, 1,000 baht for 30 minutes is expensive. I recommend going elsewhere, where the price is 300 baht per hour, or 500 baht for one hour. The results are the same. I've been here more than 10 times, paying anywhere from 800 baht for 30 minutes to 1,000 baht for 30 minutes. It doesn't meet my needs. In short, I don't recommend it. They also offer bone adjustments using traction, but it doesn't cure the problem. People with aches and pains and herniated discs should find ways to stretch themselves. Swimming is the best exercise.

The advantage is that the staff are Thai traditional medicine graduates, and the service is excellent. The place is clean and meets clinic standards. Unfortunately, the treatment isn't effective and the price is too high.

This is definitely one of the best massages. Probably the best. It's more like a medical massage; I would recommend it for pain. She even showed me a few exercises. The price was 900 baht for a one-hour treatment, which was even longer, about 1 hour and 20 minutes. I think the price is very reasonable, as they are more specialized than many others. They also speak English.

I was treated for back pain from sitting at work, combined with being thin. The doctor said my back muscles were weak. I had deep, tight, and aching shoulder and back pain. The doctor was able to press very hard. At first, I thought I would be in pain from the pressure, but I woke up without any pain at all. I recommend Thai traditional medicine for anyone who needs massage therapy for pain relief.
